speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent, and I will be asking you a series of questions to determine the cause of your acute diarrhea. To begin, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is a significant amount of diarrhea in a short time. Given your recent treatment for pneumonia with levofloxacin, are you experiencing any fever, severe abdominal pain, or visible blood or mucus in your stool?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Stool_Cultures, Stool_Ova_and_Parasites, Stool_Clostridioides_difficile_toxin

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: Hemoglobin 13 g/dL, Total_Count_WBC 13,400/mm3, Differential_Count Neutrophils 80%, Lymphocytes 15%, Monocytes 5%; Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel: NORMAL READINGS; Stool_Cultures: Pending; Stool_Ova_and_Parasites: NORMAL READINGS; Stool_Clostridioides_difficile_toxin: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: The white blood cell count is elevated with neutrophilia, but your C. difficile and stool cultures are negative. Given your recent use of levofloxacin, have you noticed any mucus in your stool, or have you been taking any other medications recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Watery diarrhea. I also have Lower abdominal discomfort, Abdominal cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (likely *Clostridioides difficile* infection despite negative initial toxin, or other post-antibiotic enteric pathogens) given the recent levofloxacin use, significant leukocytosis with neutrophilia, and absence of other infectious causes.

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CXR (to assess for complications of prior pneumonia or aspiration).

Please describe the frequency of your bowel movements and whether you have experienced any recent travel or foodborne exposures.
